intro: MEED+ checks every candidate action against the laws that apply to your municipality. Actions your city lacks the legal authority to implement independently are excluded from the ranking before scoring begins.
feasibility-note: Legal verdict shapes 34% of the feasibility score · feasibility shapes 23% of the ranking
precondition-title: Legal screening runs when your ranking is generated
precondition-body: Finish the remaining wizard steps and generate your ranking — MEED+ will then screen each candidate action against local laws, and any blocked or flagged actions will appear here. You can continue to the next step now.
all-passed-title: All actions passed the legal review
all-passed-body: No actions were excluded or flagged based on legal authority requirements.
blocked-section-description: These actions were removed before scoring. The city does not currently have the legal authority to implement them independently.
flagged-section-description: No legal assessment was found for these actions. They are included in the ranking with a neutral legal score.
flagged-card-body: No legal assessment is available for this action yet. It is included in the ranking with a neutral legal score.
